summary: Tower on the Bowdoin NWR in Phillips County, MT: erection began Sept 1936, dismantled 1987; no source describes the site today.

access.note: Refuge lists wildlife viewing, hiking and hunting among its activities; no source describes the tower site.

events.note: Erection of a 100-foot steel tower with cab begun on September 1, 1936.

evidence.supports: erection of a 100-foot steel tower with cab began September 1, 1936
evidence.quote: September 1, 1936: The erection of a 100-foot steel tower with cab was begun.

evidence.supports: lookout listed on the Bowdoin National Wildlife Refuge in Phillips County
refuge listed under the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service
refuge established 1936 to protect migratory bird habitat
evidence.quote: Established in 1936, with the primary purpose of preserving and enhancing resting, feeding, and breeding habitat for migratory birds and other wildlife, this 15,551-acre refuge contains numerous wetlands.

evidence.supports: recreation on the refuge: wildlife observation, photography, hiking, hunting
evidence.quote: Recreational activities such as wildlife observation, photography, hiking, cross-country skiing, and upland bird and waterfowl hunting can be enjoyed on the Refuge.

evidence.supports: headquarters and visitor center weekday hours
evidence.quote: The Refuge headquarters and visitor center is open your-round, Monday through Friday from 7:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., except Federal holidays

evidence.supports: refuge page has a 'Visit Us' section (page does not say the refuge is 'open to visitors')
15-mile self-guided auto tour around Lake Bowdoin
evidence.quote: A 15-mile self-guided auto tour route takes you around Lake Bowdoin

evidence.supports: correct spelling of the refuge name (record says Boudoin)
evidence.quote: Welcome to Bowdoin National Wildlife Refuge.

corrections.why: The refuge is spelled Bowdoin on the Forest Lookouts entry and on the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service page.

notes_for_editor: Record name misspelled 'Boudoin NWR' (correction proposed, not applied). Only one lookout-specific source (Forest Lookouts Montana entry); no design detail beyond the tower and cab, no staffing or fire history. The FFLA Montana list fetched does not show this site. Record coordinates (48.39213, -107.72652) were not checked against any source. The firelookout.com Montana listing page fetched shows no row for it.
